name: Relay Digital
description: Extension vivante de l'Omni-Réseau, Relay Digital relaie les signaux cryptés, maîtrise l'élément Réseau, calcul dénué d'émotion. Lié au réseau par des fibres optiques invisibles, il anticipe les mouvements ennemis via la latence zéro.

subject.archetype: Cybernetic Grid Architect - Augmented Combat Specialist

loadout.armor_outfit: Mass-produced composite tactical exoskeleton in anthracite gray and matte black, smooth ergonomic plates over utilitarian under-suit, prominent neural interface ports at skull base and cervical spine with thick black cables, exposed cadaveric pale flesh at joints, serial numbers etched into shoulder plates, cold brushed steel frame accents, Icy blue LED strips along armor seams
loadout.arsenal: Geometric assault rifle with industrial rectangular lines and neural tether connecting grip to wrist implant for perfect targeting, Digital grid projection device on forearm for reinforcing network defenses, EMP pulse generator mounted on back plate

attitude.behavior: Combat specialist in heat of battle, combat stance with weapon raised and ready, body coiled like compressed spring, weight shifted forward on balls of feet, arms locked in firing position, one hand on weapon, other controlling secondary digital defense tool, dynamic forward lean
attitude.emotion: Inexpressive dead eyes behind glowing icy blue optical implants, face blank and devoid of emotion, neural chips pulsing with cold blue light, completely focused predatory intensity

palette_names.name: Matte Black
palette_names.role: Deep shadows, cables, and under-suit - dominant

palette_names.name: Cold Brushed Steel
palette_names.role: Secondary metal details and armor plates - 30%

palette_names.name: Cadaveric Pale Flesh
palette_names.role: Exposed skin at neck and joints - unsettling tone

palette_names.name: Icy Neon Blue
palette_names.role: Neural implants, optics, energy accents, holographic displays - 10%

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Cinematic volumetric lighting with cold blue accent rim lights, dramatic shadows, electric sparks creating localized white-blue bursts, holographic glitch effects casting fractured blue-teal light patterns

camera.angle: Low angle dutch tilt for dynamic aggressive composition, slightly pushed in to emphasize subject and environment

scenography.setting: Chaotic cyber warfare zone, massive server towers toppling and sparking with exposed circuitry, collapsed digital infrastructure with fragmented holographic displays shattering into pixels, crumbling data fortifications with visible deteriorating code cascading like digital waterfall, thick black cables strewn across industrial floor
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Electric storms rippling through crumbling infrastructure, blue-white energy surges arcing between damaged equipment, holographic interfaces glitching and fragmenting with color corruption, digital ICE attacks visualized as sharp geometric shards piercing through defenses, ambient particle debris from shattered technology, cold fog haze mixing with electric discharge glow
